source: Blender 5.2.2 (arm64, macOS) debug build /tmp/blender-dbg, lldb hooks on BM_face_split_edgenet_connect_islands, BM_edge_create and bvhtree_test_edges_isect_2d_ray_cb. Records use the same format as coplanar_float.json: f32 bit patterns, vertex ids numbered by first appearance (ring, loop edges, net, new edges), loop_edges and net_init keep stored (v1, v2) order.
notes: Exact BVH distance tie, Blender 5.2.2 debug build, FLOAT UNION, top face z=1 of host [-1,1]^3. Operand: two prisms z in [-2,2]: notch polygon (0.5,0),(0.25,0.25),(1.5,0.25),(1.5,-0.25),(0.25,-0.25) and triangle (-0.75,-0.5),(-0.25,0),(-0.75,0.5). The face loop has 6 vertices and the net has 13 cut edges (FLOAT intersect splits the notch arms at quarter points, (0.4375,0.0625,1) and (0.3125,-0.1875,1)). Connect origin O=(-0.25,0,1), the triangle's max-x vertex (record id 14), casts +x. The first hit is the notch tip P=(0.5,0,1), shared by two net edges: edge_arr index 1 = P-(0.3125,-0.1875,1) and index 6 = P-(0.4375,0.0625,1). Both are at distance exactly 0.75 (isect_ray_seg_v2 r_lambda bits 0x3f400000 for each, captured with lldb). The BVH callback order for this cast is indexes 9,17,7,1,6 (dist before: MAX,MAX,1.25,1.25,0.75). Index 1 is reached first and sets dist 0.75; index 6 then fails the strict dist < best test. Blender connects O to (0.3125,-0.1875,1) (record id 9); the other arm would have given (0.4375,0.0625,1). The min-x origin (-0.75,-0.5,1) connects to (-1,-1,1) with no tie. Both new edges were BM_edge_create calls with new=true.
